vulnerability.name: USN-6997-2
vulnerability.description: USN-6997-1 fixed a vulnerability in LibTIFF. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that LibTIFF incorrectly handled memory. An attacker  could possibly use this issue to cause the application to crash, resulting  in a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: LibTIFF could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
